examples.label: Email notification preferences with four checkboxes
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-fieldset" site="Global" id="fieldset-email-prefs" legend="Email notifications" class="max-w-md">
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="prefs-weekly-digest" name="notifications[]" value="digest" label="Weekly digest of new posts" checked />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="prefs-comment-replies" name="notifications[]" value="replies" label="Someone replies to my comment" checked />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="prefs-mentions" name="notifications[]" value="mentions" label="I am mentioned by name" />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="prefs-product-news" name="notifications[]" value="product" label="Product announcements and release notes" />
  </:control>
</.component>

examples.label: Delivery speed chooser with three shipping options
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-fieldset" site="Global" id="fieldset-shipping" legend="Delivery speed" space="small" class="max-w-md">
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="shipping-standard" name="shipping" value="standard" label="Standard — 3 to 5 working days, free" checked />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="shipping-express" name="shipping" value="express" label="Express — next working day, $12" />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-radio-field" site="Global" id="shipping-pickup" name="shipping" value="pickup" label="Collect in store — ready in 2 hours, free" />
  </:control>
</.component>

examples.label: Billing address group with street, city and postcode
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-fieldset" site="Global" id="fieldset-billing" legend="Billing address" padding="medium" class="max-w-lg">
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="billing-street" name="billing[street]" label="Street address" placeholder="14 Valiasr Street" value="" size="small" />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="billing-city" name="billing[city]" label="City" placeholder="Tehran" value="" size="small" />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="billing-postcode" name="billing[postcode]" label="Postal code" placeholder="1966733451" value="" size="small" />
  </:control>
</.component>

examples.label: Terms consent group showing a validation error
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-fieldset" site="Global" id="fieldset-consent" legend="Before you continue" variant="outline" color="danger" errors={["You must accept the terms before your account can be created."]} class="max-w-md">
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="consent-terms" name="consent[terms]" value="true" label="I accept the terms of service and the privacy policy" />
  </:control>
  <:control>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="consent-marketing" name="consent[marketing]" value="true" label="Send me occasional product news (optional)" />
  </:control>
</.component>
